description.value:
Nautolans are an amphibious, head-tentacled humanoid species from the ocean world of Glee Anselm, adapted for life in the deep waters of their homeworld's seas. Their fleshy head-tentacles, called montrals in some traditions and simply tentacles in others, allow Nautolans to sense the emotional and pheromonal state of those around them with startling accuracy.

Naturally strong swimmers with an intuitive grasp of body language, Nautolans often serve as bounty hunters, guards, and Jedi, their heightened senses making them difficult to surprise or deceive.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe both air and water, and you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Pheromone Sense
traits.description: Your head-tentacles detect subtle chemical and emotional cues in those around you. You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks, and you can't be surprised while conscious.

traits.name: Strong Swimmer
traits.description: You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made while swimming.
